title: Cornet versus trumpet and Armstrong wanting little George's gold trumpet
summary: A cornet is harder to blow than a trumpet; Armstrong wanted to buy little George's gold trumpet, which was stolen; she kept her husband's cornet.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Cornet or trumpet: choosing and owning horns
